description: Local AI, tuned to one model. Runs open-weight models on your own GPU.

script: $strataApp = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Strata'; $strataExe = Join-Path $strataApp 'strata-desktop.exe'; $strataDeadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(5); do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } while ((Get-Date) -lt $strataDeadline -and -not (Test-Path $strataExe)); if (-not (Test-Path $strataExe)) { throw 'Strata installer did not complete' }

notes: ALL current Strata releases (0.2.12/0.2.13 tested) ship a strata-desktop.exe with a hardcoded build-machine path (C:\w212app/.../host/server/index.mjs) and crash on start: 'the App Host entry is missing'. Upstream packaging bug, not fixable in this manifest. Manifest retained for when a fixed release ships; checkver will detect new versions.
